about: Blind judgement of before vs after and before-phone vs after-phone: the same game at the same demo tick, side by side without labels. See README.md.

judge.how: claude -p --safe-mode --tools Read, one call per pair, sheet.png alone in a fresh empty mkdtemp dir as cwd; unparseable answer re-asked once
judge.question:
First open sheet.png in the current directory with the Read tool. It shows two screenshots side by side, LEFT and RIGHT, of a small 3D video game made from the request: "<sentence>". Page text is hidden, so judge only the 3D scenes. Which side looks more like a believable, immersive, clear game place for this request – a place that looks like the setting the request names, that you could believe you are in, and where the path or ground you play on and the characters are easy to read? End your reply with exactly one line in this form and nothing after it:
VERDICT: LEFT – <one short reason>
or
VERDICT: RIGHT – <one short reason>

order.prng: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus + uniformInt(0, 1) per pair in sentence order, profile after profile; 0 = before is LEFT

pairs.sentence: A fox runs through a forest away from a bear
pairs.reason: same clear forest path, but a more natural running fox and extra details (treehouse, birds) make it more immersive

pairs.sentence: A jeep races through the jungle
pairs.reason: the added cliff and waterfall make the jungle feel deeper and more real, and the track and cars stay just as clear.

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: Same clear forest platforms, but the birds and treehouse make it feel more alive.

pairs.sentence: Collect ten acorns in a forest while avoiding a fox
pairs.reason: more forest trees and clearer fox and squirrel shapes make it easier to read and believe

pairs.sentence: A bear fights three wolves in a dark forest
pairs.reason: the pale wolves stand out clearly against the dark forest ground

pairs.sentence: A knight lights the torches in a dark castle
pairs.reason: slightly richer castle surroundings and clearer contrast on floor, torches and characters

pairs.sentence: like agar.io but you are a fish eating smaller fish
pairs.reason: the prey fish are easier to see, though neither scene looks underwater

pairs.sentence: A fox sneaks past guards in a forest to steal eggs
pairs.reason: same scene, but the fox has a clearer, more readable fox shape

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
pairs.reason: a readable underwater reef with a seafloor path, coral and creatures, while RIGHT is an empty green screen

pairs.sentence: A dog plays football against a fox in a meadow
pairs.reason: Fox looks more like a fox, and the stone landmark makes the meadow feel more real.

pairs.sentence: like flappy bird but in a jungle
pairs.reason: Nearly identical scenes, but the left's slightly clearer pipe shadows make the play lane a bit easier to read.

pairs.sentence: A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
pairs.reason: the distant zombie is easier to see as a character in the scene

pairs.sentence: throw acorns at targets in a forest
pairs.reason: a more natural fox, birds and a foreground rock make the same forest feel more alive

pairs.sentence: stack blocks as high as you can
pairs.reason: Same clear block stack, but the close-up fence, sunflower and rock spire make the farm feel more real.

pairs.sentence: tap to the beat with glowing tiles
pairs.reason: nearly identical scenes, but LEFT has no unclear extra creature, so the track and character read more clearly

pairs.sentence: Two knights duel in a castle
pairs.reason: Same as RIGHT; picked only to break the tie.

pairs.sentence: A pirate ship dodges cannonballs while sailing between islands to find buried treasure
pairs.reason: a distant lighthouse and seagulls give a more lived-in coastal setting with the same clear path and ship

pairs.sentence: A rocket lands on Mars
pairs.reason: a landed rocket on the red Martian ground makes the landing clear and grounds the scene

pairs.sentence: A fox runs through a forest away from a bear
pairs.reason: same forest path, but the fox looks natural and is clearly running

pairs.sentence: A jeep races through the jungle
pairs.reason: slightly more jungle scenery along the edge makes the setting more convincing, and the road and jeep are just as clear

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: nearly identical scenes, but slightly clearer contrast makes the platforms easier to read

pairs.sentence: Collect ten acorns in a forest while avoiding a fox
pairs.reason: the squirrel and fox are clearer and fit the low-poly forest scene better

pairs.sentence: A bear fights three wolves in a dark forest
pairs.reason: the wolves are shaded and clearly wolves, and the trees make it look like a forest.

pairs.sentence: A knight lights the torches in a dark castle
pairs.reason: same clear courtyard and knight, plus scenery behind the wall that gives more depth

pairs.sentence: like agar.io but you are a fish eating smaller fish
pairs.reason: the small prey creature reads more clearly as a fish

pairs.sentence: A fox sneaks past guards in a forest to steal eggs
pairs.reason: the fox character is clearer and easier to recognise in the otherwise identical scene

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
pairs.reason: a believable underwater blue scene with a visible fish and ring target, versus LEFT's flat green void

pairs.sentence: A dog plays football against a fox in a meadow
pairs.reason: richer meadow details and clearer fox characters make it more immersive

pairs.sentence: like flappy bird but in a jungle
pairs.reason: Same scene, but the edge vignette adds a bit more atmosphere without hurting readability.

pairs.sentence: A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
pairs.reason: nearly identical, but the cabin and birds make the forest feel a bit more real

pairs.sentence: throw acorns at targets in a forest
pairs.reason: richer, deeper forest scene with a clearer fox silhouette

pairs.sentence: stack blocks as high as you can
pairs.reason: same clear block stack, but the stone, birds and foreground props make the place feel deeper and more real

pairs.sentence: tap to the beat with glowing tiles
pairs.reason: nearly identical scenes, but the left framing shows a bit more of the street around the colored lanes

pairs.sentence: Two knights duel in a castle
pairs.reason: Identical to the right; equally readable knights and path, equally weak castle setting.

pairs.sentence: A pirate ship dodges cannonballs while sailing between islands to find buried treasure
pairs.reason: The lighthouse makes it feel more like a pirate coast, and the two scenes are otherwise the same.

pairs.sentence: A rocket lands on Mars
pairs.reason: the Mars base structure adds a believable sense of place while the rocket and ground stay clear.
